subject: prd/feature-implementation-drive
statement: When all required candidate evidence is current and accepted, the feature drive shall raise one final operator-reviewed proposal from the feature branch to main without approving or landing it.
rationale: Present one complete result while keeping landing outside the drive.
fit_criterion: Exactly one final proposal identifies current F, M, C and the scenario-set fingerprint. Hosted mode retains authenticated human merge and the required candidate verdict with current-base enforcement. Explicit local-git mode requires the complete accepted candidate-evidence/v1 envelope and every required scenario result, retained at an immutable origin ref and embedded in the final proposal. The declared once-only receipt binds proposal generation, head, target, F/M/C, scenario set, and evidence ref/object id/digest. The operator route atomically leases main M to a child L with tree(C), feature F to its retained child marker with tree(C), and a distinct final-proposal branch at F to deletion, together with final proposal/archive evidence. Any moved ref, absent/altered evidence, unaccepted result, or inconsistent receipt refuses landing and post-crash completion. The drive invokes zero local landing operations.
